SAMARTH SHUKLA
Lucknow, UP, India | jobsforsamarth@gmail.com | +91-8840207686 | Linkedin

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
CFA Level I Candidate and Finance Professional with 2+ years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, financial modeling, and equity research. Demonstrated expertise in building 3-statement models, DCF valuations, and scenario analysis for fundraising and M&A transactions valued at $50M+. Proven track record in variance analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and delivering data-driven insights that optimize capital allocation and drive strategic decision-making. Proficient in advanced Excel modeling, financial databases, Python automation, and PowerPoint presentations for C-suite stakeholders.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Investment Banking Analyst – Founder's Office | Jan 2026 – Present
Vedika API (Astrology SaaS Platform) – Series A Fundraising
• Spearheaded financial modeling and FP&A initiatives for $8M Series A fundraising, building comprehensive 5-year integrated financial models with P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections achieving 487% QoQ revenue growth trajectory
• Conducted DCF valuation analysis and comparable company benchmarking across 15+ SaaS competitors, deriving enterprise value of $42M through multi-scenario weighted average cost of capital (WACC) modeling with sensitivity tables
• Developed monthly variance analysis reports and KPI dashboards tracking 25+ metrics including CAC, LTV, ARR, MRR, gross margin expansion from 68% to 82%, and customer retention at 94%, enabling data-driven executive decision-making
• Created investor-ready pitch decks and CIM (Confidential Information Memorandum) materials for institutional VCs, articulating financial strategy, unit economics, and capital allocation priorities for $50M+ funding pipeline
• Automated financial reporting workflows using Python and Excel VBA, reducing monthly close cycle time by 60% and improving forecast accuracy to 96% through advanced time-series analysis and regression modeling

Financial Planning & Analysis Intern | May 2024 – Jun 2024
ADSMIT MEDIA Solutions – Digital Marketing Agency
• Executed comprehensive equity research on 50+ publicly traded securities across TMT, consumer, and financial services sectors, performing fundamental analysis, ratio analysis, and sector rotation strategies
• Built multi-tab Excel models with income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow forecasting for 10 mid-cap companies, identifying $12M in undervalued opportunities through discounted cash flow and EV/EBITDA multiple analysis
• Generated weekly investment committee reports with buy/hold/sell recommendations based on quantitative screening, technical indicators, and macroeconomic trend analysis, contributing to 18% alpha generation

Advanced Excel (Financial Modeling, VBA, Power Query, Pivot Tables, Macros, INDEX-MATCH, XLOOKUP, Data Tables) • Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Financial Analysis Libraries) • SQL • PowerPoint (Executive Presentations) • Financial Databases (Bloomberg Terminal, Capital IQ, FactSet) • Valuation Software • Statistical Analysis (Jamovi, R) • Data Visualization (Tableau, Power BI)
